title: Phase 2 - Taxes for the grid operator (2)

storage.value:
User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to create and manage nomenclature for ‘Taxes for the grid operator’

So that I will have a possibility to change values without system deployment

 

Design: Nomenclatures_Bundle_final (adobe.com)

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Check permission to see the nomenclature for 'Taxes for the grid operator'

  2. The nomenclature name should be 'Taxes for the grid operator'

  3. Not to be able to edit/delete nomenclature name

  4. Selecting 'Taxes for the grid operator' in the nomenclature dropdown will do the following:

    1. In right panel list of nomenclature items will be loaded:

      1. Name is displayed in the list

      2. Blue color for active items

      3. Red color for inactive items

      4. Deleted items are not displayed

    2. 'Plus' button is active if user has permission 'Create Taxes for the grid operator nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    3. ‘A-Z' button is active if user has permission ‘Edit Taxes for the grid operator nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    4. 'A (Move to top)' icon is active if user has permission 'Edit Taxes for the grid operator nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    5. ‘Remove' icon is active if user has permission 'Edit Taxes for the grid operator nomenclature’

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    6. Pagination will always appear

      1. Number of records dropdowns will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

      2. 25 is selected by default

    7. Search box will appear in footer

      1. It is possible to search by Type of disconnection, Grid operator or Supplier type

      2. By default search icon is gray and becomes active after typing 1 symbol in search box

      3. Clicking on ‘Search’ Icon will run search

      4. 'X' button next to search icon will clear search results and will empty the search field

      5. Changing the nomenclature will empty the search field

  5. Scroll/Pagination

    • Footer is always fixed to bottom, so Search box, number of records and pagination is not hidden on scrolling

    • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter or leave the field will directly load that page. If page number is not valid or does not exist the field should be cleared after clicking on Enter or leave the field

    •  ‘Plus’ button/'A-Z' icon is displayed in each page and page is scrollable

  6. Update order of added nomenclature items:

    • Sort order will be used for displaying items in dropdowns in system

    • Newly added item will always be added as last item

    • Clicking on ‘A-Z’ icon will reorder all items alphabetically. 

      • After ordering alphabetically user will be able to modify ordering manually using drag and drop within the page, no possibility to drag & drop between pages

      • ‘Move To Top’ icon will move selected item First in the list and all other items order will be shifted by one

      • in search results state Drag & Drop action is not active; Only ‘Move to Top’ action will be active

  7. To able to add nomenclature items by ‘Plus’ button:

    1. Type of disconnection

      1. Mandatory

      2. Name should be unique for a Grid operator for a Supplier type

      3. Type: Text area

      4. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      5. Length 1-1024 characters

    2. Document template

      1. Mandatory

      2. Enabled

      3. Single select dropdown

        1. The list is manageable from the template. The list should display only templates where the purpose is 'Email' and type of template is Document; deleted templates should not be visible."

        2. Templates should be displayed with its name and ID in format Name (ID)

        3. It is possible to search templates with its name or ID

        4. List will be sorted by creation date; Newly added template will be recorded as last item.

        5. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

        6. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

        7. After Selecting template in Pop-up window and clicking on ‘OK’ button will close pop-up window and selected Template should be listed in deposit page

          • Should display added template in format Name (ID)

    3. Email template

      • mandatory

      • Enabled

      • Single select dropdown

        1. The list is manageable from the template. The list should display only templates where the purpose is 'Email' and document type is Email; deleted templates should not be visible."

        2. Templates should be displayed with its name and ID in format Name (ID)

        3. It is possible to search templates with its name or ID

        4. List will be sorted by creation date; Newly added template will be recorded as last item.

        5. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

        6. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

        7. After Selecting template in Pop-up window and clicking on ‘OK’ button will close pop-up window and selected Template should be listed in deposit page

          1. Should display added template in format Name (ID)

      • When Email template and Customer is added the system should display preview of the template in the Email body field

      • It is possible to open template page by clocking on it and open in a new browser tab from deposit

      • It is possible to delete selected template from the deposit by clicking on delete icon

    4. Number of income account

      1. Mandatory

      2. Text field

      3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      4. Length: 1 – 32 characters

      5. Enabled

    5. Basis for issuing

      1. Optional

      2. Text field

      3. Allowed symbols: A-Z a-z 0-9

      4. Length: 1-1024 characters

    6. Cost center / Controlling order

      1. Mandatory

      2. enabled

      3. Text field

      4. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      5. Length: 1 – 32 characters

    7. Price component or Price component Group or Item

      1. Text field

      2. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      3. Length 1-1024 characters

    8. Grid operator

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

      3. List is manageable from nomenclature

        1. Active values should be returned

        2. Order should be considered

        3. Display default if returned from nomenclature

    9. Supplier type

      1. Mandatory

      2. Radio buttons with two hardcoded values:

        1. Current

        2. Previous

    10. Tax for reconnection

      1. Mandatory

      2. Text field

      3. Allowed symbols: 0-9 .

      4. Length: 1-8 characters, 2 digits after the decimal point

    11. Tax for express reconnection

      1. Mandatory

      2. Text field

      3. Allowed symbols: 0-9 .

      4. Length: 1-8 characters, 2 digits after the decimal point

    12. Currency

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

      3. List is manageable from nomenclature

        1. Active values should be returned

        2. Order should be considered

        3. Display default if returned from nomenclature

    13. Remove tax in Cancelation

      1. Checkbox

      2. Empty by default

    14. Default for POD with measurement type SLP

      1. Checkbox

      2. Empty by default

      3. It is possible to have only one default value for a Grid operator for a Supplier type

    15. Default for POD with measurement type By settlement period

      1. Checkbox

      2. Empty by default

      3. It is possible to have only one default value for a Grid operator for a Supplier type

  8. To be able to edit nomenclature item name

    • if user have only Viewing permission, in Pop-up window will be disabled editing option

  9. To be able to remove item from nomenclature

    1. Should display message:

      1. Clicking on Yes will remove nomenclature

      2. Clicking on Cancel will close popup

  10. if an object is connected to this nomenclature item in system nomenclature can’t be deleted

    1. if an object is connected “Display Warning message ''

  11. To be able to make nomenclature item inactive

    1. No matter object e.g. Taxes for the grid operator is connected or not we need possibility to mark status as inactive.

      1. In create Taxes for the grid operator page inactive item will not be visible in dropdown

      2. In edit Taxes for the grid operator page will be visible but clicking on a dropdown to edit will load only active items, so will not be able to see inactive values in the dropdown itself

  12. Audit Log

    • Audit Log record should be created on adding/Editing/Removing actions 

    • No need to create Audit Log record on Move to top/Drag & Drop
